tolerance.metric: maximum rotation-stage stress normalized by elastic modulus
tolerance.rationale: Declared before solve; isolates the exact rigid-rotation invariant without relying on a hyperelastic material registration.

notes: The original componentwise max-stress comparison was not objective and produced the flat false FAIL. This verifier compares principal stresses, which are invariant under rigid rotation; normalized residuals are [1.8772578602721524e-14, 1.1900405771925193e-14, 1.2949953753782495e-13]. The finest (dt=0.005) passes the predeclared criterion; the non-monotone tiny trend is roundoff, not a claimed convergence order.
limitations: One-element elastic rotation regression; no Neo-Hookean stress-stretch curve and no independent large-strain tensile bar.
